subject: Scientific Instruments Change - Lake Ontario - Hamilton
text:
Scientific Instruments Change - Lake Ontario - Hamilton
Subsurface scientific mooring temporarily established 5 metres below the surface from 43 17.172N 079 51.117W
to 43 17.173N 079 51.086W.
The mooring has two points; the first being the scientific instrumentation and the second being the end of the poly line.
Mariners are requested to stay clear 100 metres and not set nets or drag the lakebed between the two points.
